name: Labarum
description: A labarum: a staff and a crossbar meeting at the centre of the block.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 78%; top: 0; width: 22%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 78%; width: 100%; height: 22%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: scale(1, 1); transform: scale(1, 1); @match(@x % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(-1, 1); transform: scale(-1, 1); } @match(@y % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(1, -1); transform: scale(1, -1); } @match(@x % 2 + @y % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(-1, -1); transform: scale(-1, -1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
